UX surface Boot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

OPTION_SEL

Selector matching any rendered option button (locale or theme row).

GRID_SEL

Selector matching the options grid that wraps the buttons.

moveFollower

Positions the glass follower over btn (transform only — no layout).

updateToActive

Snaps the follower back onto the active locale's button.

BOUND_HOSTS

Hosts whose once-only bindings exist — Escape/resize + delegated follower.

bindDelegatedFollower

Tracks pointer/focus movement across the option grid through a single delegated listener set on the persistent shadow root. Re-rendering swaps the option nodes wholesale every store update, so per-node listeners would both re-bind and strand dead disposers on the host until disconnect; delegation resolves the live target at event time instead.

bindWindowDismissal

Window-level dismissal + follower-reposition bindings plus the delegated follower tracking. Bound once per element — re-running bindEvents after each store update would otherwise pile duplicate window listeners onto the persistent element (its disposers only drain on disconnect, which never happens for a shell child). Handlers query the live shadow tree so stale-node captures are impossible.

bindEvents

Repositions the follower after each open/re-render and binds the once-only window + delegated listeners. Option/backdrop/close clicks are JSX onClick props on the rendered buttons — duplicating them here would fire selectLang/close twice per click.
